name: @tangram/ai
//: docs/plans/wave-zero.md §5's deliverable 5 — the provider contract, grounding, the prompts, the cache key and data.md D3's retrieve.ts, shared by apps/app and (from backend.md B1) apps/server. The eleven modules moved here from apps/app/lib/ai/** in one commit with their 66 import sites; `apps/app/lib/ai/` is now empty and backend.md B2's browser-side ask-client.ts is the only thing that goes back into it. The exports map gains a `./*` wildcard and KEEPS `.` pointing at schemas.ts: the frozen ask contract is what a server consumer means by a bare `@tangram/ai`, index.ts does not re-export it, and repointing `.` at the barrel would have changed the meaning of an import nothing in the tree has written yet. TWO DEBTS, BOTH RECORDED IN HANDOFF.md. The first predates this package; the SECOND IS THIS MOVE'S OWN — before it, packages/ai held only the import-free schemas.ts and depended on nothing. (1) THE EXPORTS MAP POINTS AT TYPESCRIPT SOURCE: these modules export runtime values and apps/server emits plain JavaScript that plain `node` loads. Node's type stripping handles the .ts itself today only because pnpm symlinks a workspace package and node's realpath lands outside node_modules; against a deploy artifact where @tangram/ai is a real directory under node_modules the same emitted dist/index.js fails with ERR_UNSUPPORTED_NODE_MODULES_TYPE_STRIPPING. And plain `node` does not get that far for ten of the twelve modules anyway: the intra-package imports are spelled ./x.js, the resolver does not substitute .ts for a .js specifier with no file behind it, and only deadline.ts and schemas.ts (which import nothing) load. The .js spelling is deliberate and is not the regression it looks like — extensionless ./x, which is what the move first wrote, is unresolvable in ESM too AND unresolvable under apps/server's nodenext typecheck, while ./x.js is what a real emit needs and is what lets tsc resolve the package under bundler and nodenext alike. Whoever needs the server to load this package must add a build emitting dist/*.js + .d.ts and point exports at {types, import}. (2) THIS PACKAGE IS NOT YET SELF-CONTAINED: eight of its twelve modules read `@/lib/**` out of apps/app — anthropic, cache-key, examples, fake, ground, prompts, provider and retrieve, across eight app modules (lib/types, lib/dev/sha1, lib/db/repository, lib/db/schema, lib/srs/profile, lib/srs/states, lib/dict/rank, lib/dict/store). Most of those edges are `import type` and are erased at emit, but SIX are runtime values and are not: sha1Hex (cache-key.ts), hasCjk (retrieve.ts), and isPhraseSnapshot/KNOWN_SAMPLE_LIMIT/wordState/parseEntryId (examples.ts). backend.md B1 already owns breaking the lib/db coupling in examples.ts by injection; that ruling has to cover cache-key.ts and retrieve.ts too — two more files, not three — before apps/server can import anything here. The `@/*` mapping in tsconfig.json is what makes the package typecheck in the meantime, and it is a debt, not a design.
